question: Which of the following terms was used for tanks or ponds in Gupta records?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tadaga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The term **"Tadaga"** was used in Gupta-era inscriptions and records to refer to tanks or ponds.
 
• These tanks or ponds were constructed for **irrigation, water conservation, and public utility** purposes.
 
• The Gupta period is known for its advancements in agricultural infrastructure, including the creation of **water storage systems like Tadaga**.
 
• Such water bodies were often associated with **religious and social activities**, highlighting the cultural significance of water management during the Gupta era.
 
• Gupta inscriptions also mention the donation of tanks and ponds by wealthy individuals or rulers for the welfare of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gupta Dynasty**

 
 
• The Gupta Empire (circa 320–550 CE) is often referred to as the **Golden Age of India** due to advancements in art, science, and infrastructure.
 
• The rulers of this era were known for their patronage of education, literature, and engineering projects, including water management systems.
 
 
 
• **Water Management in Ancient India**
 
 
• Water management systems like **tanks, wells, stepwells, and canals** were crucial for agriculture and daily life.
 
• Such structures were often built using public funds or donations from wealthy patrons.
 
 
 
• **Other Terms in Gupta Records**
 
 
• **Nadi:** Refers to rivers or flowing water bodies.
 
• **Kshetra:** Denotes fields or agricultural lands.
 
• **Prapa:** Refers to rest houses or shelters, often with water facilities for travelers.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance of Water Bodies**
 
 
• Water bodies were often associated with **temples and religious rituals**.
 
• They were also venues for community gatherings and social events, showcasing their multifaceted role in society.
